referenceFunction.generalComment: This dataset describes the transformation from high to medium voltage as well as the transmission of electricity at medium voltage.; UUID:baf52276-8f3a-3683-b0df-77e80f0748dc
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: Included are the electricity production in Switzerland and from imports, the transmission network and direct SF6-emissions to air. Electricity losses during medium-voltage transmission and transformation from high-voltage are accounted for.

geography.text: Data apply to public and self producers. Geographical classification according to IEA. Transmission network, losses and emissions are taken from Itten, Frischknecht and Stucki (2014): LCI of Electricity Mixes and Grid.

technology.text: Average technology used to transmit and distribute electricity. Includes underground and overhead lines, as well as air-, vacuum- and SF6-insulated high-to-medium voltage switching stations. Electricity production according to related datasets
